require recoveryId deterministic from canonical parent+authority binding and not runtime path; after terminal, same root/parent with a different self-consistent authorityId/hash must raise RECOVERY_AUTHORITY_CONFLICT with both child calls zero and original record unchanged

inside the retry node add fresh-root mutations of missing/extra binding key, unknown phase, attempts 0/2/bool, recoveryId drift, authority/budget hash drift, child receipt syntax/schema/hash/binding, history syntax/hash/lineage, result syntax/hash/recoveryId; include self-resealed semantic mutations by recomputing record_sha256; all raise RECOVERY_LEDGER_CORRUPT before child calls
